title: 天上の玻璃に刻む、鳥たちの記憶
author: 硝子 シオン

en.title: Engraved in Heavenly Glass: The Memories of Birds
en.premise: I am a "memory sculptor" who processes memories into gemstones. One day, a girl who has lost her memories arrives aboard a flying ship. Her missing memories have scattered to the ends of the earth in the form of translucent migratory birds. Carrying transparent despair and fragile beauty, we set out on a journey to the far reaches of the sky to gather her memories back.

zh.title: 刻于天上玻璃之上的群鸟记忆
zh.premise: 我是能将记忆加工成宝石的“记忆雕刻师”。某天，一个乘着飞船、失去了记忆的少女来到了我面前。她缺失的记忆化作晶莹剔透的候鸟，散落在了世界的尽头。我们怀揣着透明的绝望与脆弱的美丽，踏上了前往天空彼端拾回记忆的旅程。
